ModMetaData.name: [OMW] Blahaj Plush
ModMetaData.author: oldmanwhistler
ModMetaData.description:
[h1][OMW] Blahaj Plush[/h1]
Plush and furniture of the Ikea Blahaj. XML only.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oldmanwhistler/OMWBlahajPlush/refs/heads/main/Docs/Images/blahaj_plush_splash.png[/img]
I had a texture for an Ikea Blahaj for another mod I was working on an someone on discord mentioned they'd love a plush.
[h2]Mod Contents[/h2] [list] [*] Utility slot plush that gives +0.05 comfort and +10% learning [*] 1x1 buildable furniture decoration [*] 1x3 buildable furniture decoration [*] Plush and buildings will be tinted based on the material used so use white material to match the Ikea colours. [/list] [h2]In Game shots[/h2]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oldmanwhistler/OMWBlahajPlush/refs/heads/main/Docs/Images/blahaj_ingame1.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oldmanwhistler/OMWBlahajPlush/refs/heads/main/Docs/Images/blahaj_ingame2.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oldmanwhistler/OMWBlahajPlush/refs/heads/main/Docs/Images/blahaj_ingame3.png[/img]
